gates.text: Preserve source component instances and electrical connectivity through review migration
Every physical part has an unambiguous function, manufacturer part number, package, speed grade and sourcing decision
ALU and Memory instances have explicit physical gate/package allocation with preserved endpoint connectivity
Schematic supply pins, unused units and logic inputs have no unresolved structural electrical findings
Independent electrical review accepts the component choices and circuit wiring

gates.text: Representative register-ROM-buffer path passes with explicit timing monitors

Loaded output reaches the required voltage before capture in a bounded analogue experiment

normal_milestones.title: Module verification

gates.text: All 2097152 ALU addresses agree with the independently expressed data/flag contract
Both microcode images contain 65536 words, match independent encoding and reproduce the checked-in copies
Compiled control-word execution agrees with the instruction contract under reviewed phase and flag-capture semantics
Compiled JMP/CALL reaches every target and handles conditional/operand boundaries under the extracted PC model
Committed demo programs halt with expected text and bitmap through compiled control words and bounded host IO
Schematic-derived memory decode passes independent MAR/external-address/read/write cases and byte pin-route checks
Schematic-derived register slice captures every byte and releases the data bus
ALU, controller, MAR/stack and IO modules have complete schematic-derived timed integration
Schematic-derived ALU data and control paths preserve operands, ROM pin order, flag packing/hold, phase-qualified C/Z commands and bus isolation under connector stimulus

normal_milestones.summary: 7/9 acceptance gates passed. Open: MOD-03, MOD-08.

milestone_scope: The unchanged normal requirements remain authoritative. CP1 is a separately verified staged redesign; its evidence is not silently promoted into the failed normal run.
open_items: No guaranteed HCT245 IO capacitance; 10 pF per port is a stated allocation.
HCT245 data/enable timing is taken at 150 pF; disable timing is only guaranteed at 50 pF.
SN74HCT273 SCLS068H switching tables label both delay rows CLR. The 42 ns clock-to-Q simulation value requires manufacturer clarification; it is not accepted as an unambiguous clock-delay guarantee.
SRAM read table uses 30 pF; output release uses 5 pF. Actual DQ load and turnaround require qualification.
HC377 DC compatibility checked at 4.5 V only; full-supply loaded edges remain open.
MCP100-450D does not establish valid 4.75 V startup; the staged system retains an external qualified reset input.
Oscillator startup, duty at receiver thresholds, power integrity, routing and external IO electronics remain open.
Owned 191/245/574 manufacturer/suffix/counts and EPROM programmer/readback remain unresolved.
timing_scope: Sampled digital timing and allocated loads at the conditional 4 MHz oscillator / 500 kHz microcycle target. Not a full-supply worst-case electrical guarantee.

preserved_boot_watchdog_failure.reason: Inherited DEMO simulated-time watchdog is shorter than the known CP1 program schedule.
